deadline.value: Submit by 1 December 2026 for priority consideration; later applications are reviewed on a rolling basis (the FAQ also urges 15 December, with late files until about mid-January).
deadline.quote: Applications for 2027 Open Aug 17, 2026! *Submit by DECEMBER 1st, 2026 for priority consideration, Late applications accepted and reviewed on a rolling basis!

also.quote: We strongly encourage students to submit applications by December 15 for admission to the program in the following fall.

gre_general.value: The GRE General is optional; unofficial scores can be self-reported, and there is no minimum GRE or GPA.
gre_general.quote: No, the GRE exam is now optional. | The School of Chemistry and Biochemistry does not have a minimum GRE or GPA requirement for admission.

gre_subject.value: The Chemistry GRE Subject test is optional.
gre_subject.quote: Do you require the subject GRE? No, the subject GRE is optional.

toefl_min.value: Chemistry wants a TOEFL iBT of at least 100 to be considered for teaching-assistantship support (higher than the Institute minimum of 90).
toefl_min.quote: A minimum internet-based TOEFL score of 100 is required to be considered for admission with teaching assistantship support.

supervisor.value: No supervisor is needed to apply, but the school encourages you to contact faculty about shared research interests.
supervisor.quote: Is it acceptable to contact professors directly? Yes, we encourage you to contact faculty in the department to discuss mutual research interests.

funding.value: Nearly all admitted PhD students are supported as teaching assistants in year one and usually as research assistants afterwards; the stipend is USD 37,500 a year from Fall 2026 plus a tuition waiver.
funding.quote: Nearly all admitted PhD students are supported as teaching assistants in their first year. | Graduate assistants include a stipend of $37,500 per year (starting Fall 2026), and also include a waiver of tuition.

entry_route.value: You can be admitted straight into the PhD without a master's.
entry_route.quote: Do I have to earn an MS before entering the Ph.D. program? A student may be admitted directly into the PhD program.

notes: Applications open 17 August 2026. The department may consider its own fee-waiver request (button at the end of the application). 35-45 PhD students admitted each year.
